body.title: Mission: a mission a
body.body:
thread:buttons proposes a mission (tenant dev), proposal 52c3a585fb5d.

Title: a mission a

Goal: g

Success:
- done

Repos: none named
Deadline: the default (7 days from when it is made)
Up to: branch
Budget: not stated; the tenant's signed budget rule gives it when the mission is made (the mission's record has the numbers)

It needs you because it does not fit the standing envelope in force, or none is in force; the mission's record says which bound.

Starting it lets its tasks be dispatched; not starting it stops it.

body.title: Import plan R2: round 2 into the runtime
body.body:
thread:buttons proposes to import plan R2 (第 2 轮), proposal 59845626407f.

Why: round 2 into the runtime

5 items, 18 steps: 9 done (each with its ledger line as evidence; Progress counts them as manual), 4 in progress, 5 not started.

From WORK.md, 第 2 轮逐项, lines 14-39, checked at 2026-10-19 01:20.
Section sha256 8f795bdc5c9ba4d57c9f17a23487e75e8e945cdc4bb0fc189ce2d448e1a2bbb0; request sha256:31b4f36d6e6ec9fd9e3bc57758c5bf27044feeb426c1a2923f7a17b494446559.

Importing writes the plan under your decision; its nodes and numbers are then fixed and can only change by plan changes. Not importing writes nothing; the board keeps reading the ledger.
body.urgency: when you can: only this import waits for you
body.meanwhile: the plan is not imported; the board keeps reading the ledger

body.title: Import recorder log td-901: retire the recorder
body.body:
thread:buttons proposes to import the recorder log of td-901, proposal 5be84ec82f9e.

Why: retire the recorder

2 events: 1 work_closed, 1 work_opened. The hash chain holds from the first line to the last.

From td-901/events.jsonl, sha256 847b5f3776999f9909feefc1299ecb20b1b7dd23b32714995f611e3a0474357e; kept log sha256:5293e0d371533663d0fc3c45bf5c29c62905453b043f816559016ebaba3b180a.

Importing writes the log as the stream legacy:recorder:td-901, one event per line, under your decision; it is then fixed. Not importing writes nothing; the recorder keeps its log as it is.

options.label: Import the log
options.detail: the trial import checked the hash chain from the first line to the last and kept the log; it is history, so no plan or mission waits on it, and once imported it is fixed

body.urgency: when you can: only this import waits for you
body.meanwhile: the log is not imported; the recorder keeps it as it is
